title: Infrastructure Support Engineer - Contract
original_description:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

The Role

We're hiring one Infrastructure Support Engineer on a six-month contract to run day-to-day support for OLIX's production infrastructure: AWS, GitHub, Cloudflare, Terraform, Ansible, Linux and Kubernetes.

You'll be the first line for every infrastructure request across engineering — unblocking people fast, then removing the cause so the request stops coming back. The measure of success is simple: requests resolved in hours rather than days, and a queue that shrinks as automation takes over the repetitive work.

Start date: ASAP
Location: London, with working overlap for Austin and India
Contract: 6 months

Responsibilities

  • Own the infrastructure support queue, responding to every request within 15 minutes and aiming for resolution in hours, not days.

  • Resolve procedural requests end to end: access, permissions, capacity, licence installs, host rebuilds, DNS records, runner and repository administration.

  • Apply changes through Terraform and Ansible in the infra repository, by pull request.

  • Build self-service tooling and automations for common request types, removing blockers to engineering work.

  • Write and maintain runbooks for incidents affecting core infrastructure.

  • Escalate to infrastructure engineering where appropriate.

  • Monitor capacity and licence expiry, and resolve proactively before limits are hit.

  • Report weekly on volume, resolution times, top causes, and work removed by automation.


What this role does not cover: designing or building new platforms, owning the EDA platform build programme, end-user IT support (laptops, phones, Microsoft 365, identity provisioning — these stay with the IT support team), or security incident response.

Skills & Experience

Required:

  • Five or more years of Linux administration on Ubuntu or RHEL: users and permissions, filesystems, storage, networking, SSH, remote desktop.

  • AWS: EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, Secrets Manager.

  • Terraform and Ansible — reading and changing existing code, working through pull requests.

  • GitHub administration: organisations, repositories, permissions, Actions runners.

  • Experience working in a ticket queue against response and resolution targets.

  • Clear written runbooks and documentation.

Useful:

  • Cloudflare Zero Trust and WARP.

  • FlexLM licence administration.

  • SLURM and HPC or EDA compute environments.

  • Semiconductor or engineering environments using Cadence or Synopsys tools.

  • Kubernetes.

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates' eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.

This is a high-ownership role with the freedom to define our internal infrastructure, security standards, and technical operations from the ground up. You will guide your team to transform slow, manual workflows into fast, reproducible, and genuinely secure systems, while currently holding the reins for our foundational IT operations as the company expands. If you care equally about maximizing engineering velocity, establishing best-in-class security, and building a highly capable technical team, there is a massive amount of impactful work to dig into here.

 

Responsibilities

Day to day, you will guide your team and manage the strategic execution of our engineering platform and technical operations. This is a mix of strategic alignment, architectural guidance, and team enablement focused on:

  • Team Leadership & Delivery: Direct the team in building provisioning automation, CI/CD pipelines, internal tooling, network design, and observability systems.

  • Operational & IT Oversight: Ensure your team effectively supports and unblocks engineers on complex build or connectivity issues, while also steering the broader IT function, including identity management, device fleets, and SaaS administration, as we scale through this phase of growth.

  • Security Posture: Champion a secure-by-default mindset across infrastructure, endpoints, and access management.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering leaders, with compiler engineering as an early and demanding customer, to ensure the engineering platform and the broader company environment remain highly coherent and efficient.

 

Skills & Experience

title: Infrastructure Engineer
original_description:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.


The Role

We're hiring a senior infrastructure engineer to own the internal platform our engineering teams build, test, and collaborate on, spanning compute, storage, networking, build and CI/CD systems, and the security that protects all of it, while partnering with our IT function on identity, devices, and access across the company. You'll turn slow, manual, loosely secured workflows into fast, reproducible, and genuinely secure ones. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with the freedom to define how internal infrastructure, security, and the technical side of IT work here from the ground up. If you care about engineering velocity, solid networking, best-in-class security, and a well-run technical environment in equal measure, there's a lot to dig into.

 

Responsibilities

  • Build and operate the platform: design, provision, and run the Kubernetes and bare-metal infrastructure that powers development, simulation, and testing workloads.

  • Automate everything: own infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and provisioning pipelines so environments are reproducible, version-controlled, and fast to stand up or tear down.

  • Improve the developer platform: build and maintain CI/CD, internal tooling, and self-service workflows that let hardware, software, and compiler engineers ship without waiting on you.

  • Tune for performance: optimise networking (VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, and low-latency/high-bandwidth fabrics) and storage for the throughput and latency that ML and hardware workloads require.

  • Own reliability and observability: implement monitoring, alerting, and capacity planning, and drive availability and performance across hybrid cloud and on-prem environments.

  • Own platform security: implement identity and access management, secrets management, data protection, and threat detection across self-hosted and cloud infrastructure.

  • Drive continuous improvement: proactively find and fix the bottlenecks, manual steps, and reliability gaps that slow the wider engineering team down.

 

Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years in infrastructure, platform, or DevOps/SRE engineering, with a track record of owning systems end to end.

  • Strong infrastructure-as-code and automation skills: Terraform, Ansible, and scripting in Python and Bash.

  • Solid networking fundamentals.

  • Experience operating across hybrid cloud and on-prem/bare-metal environments.

  • Strong grasp of infrastructure security: IAM, secrets management, network security, and hardening across cloud and self-hosted systems.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex, cross-layer issues in a fast-moving environment.

  • A collaborative communicator who can work with hardware and ML engineers and explain infrastructure trade-offs clearly.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Compensation & Equity

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location

  • Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You’re not just joining the mission; you’re owning a piece of it

  • Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office

  • Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security.

We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). title: Senior Opto-Mechanical Engineer
original_description:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

Role

We build hardware where light does the heavy lifting. Our optical interconnect assemblies operate at the edge of what precision manufacturing can hold — and we need an engineer who knows how to design for that reality.

You'll own the mechanical architecture of photonic subassemblies: optical coupling structures, precision ferrule systems, laser source packaging, and the thermal-mechanical interfaces that keep everything aligned from assembly through field life.

You'll live in tolerance stacks, CTE budgets, and first-article reviews. When yield drops, you'll know where to look. This is a hands-on role that spans CAD to cleanroom, drawing release to supplier corrective action, FEA to thermal cycling failure analysis. You'll work directly with optical, process, and reliability engineers — and you'll be expected to hold the full causal chain between a mechanical decision and an optical outcome.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop opto-mechanical assemblies including optical coupling structures, photonic interposers, ferrule/connector systems, and precision alignment fixtures.

  • Perform tolerance chain analysis (RSS and worst-case) for optical alignment budgets, accounting for thermal excursion, assembly variation, and long-term drift.

  • Select and qualify optical-grade materials (Invar/Kovar, borosilicate glass, low-CTE adhesives) with consideration for CTE compatibility, outgassing, and process compatibility.

  • Lead thermal-mechanical co-design of photonic subassemblies, including heatsink design for ASICs and high-power laser sources Drive DFM/DFA for precision optical assemblies including MIM components, laser-machined features, and bonded/co-cured structures.

  • Generate and own GD&T drawings and engineering specifications for optical-grade fabricated parts.

  • Collaborate with process engineering, optical design, and reliability teams to define assembly process flows and qualification test plans.

  • Support FEA (thermal, structural, modal) for mechanical validation of optical subassemblies. Contribute to reliability programs including environmental stress testing (thermal cycling, vibration, shock) in alignment with applicable standards (GR-468-CORE, Telcordia GR-326, IEC 61300).

  • Experience with OCP standards and rack design preferred.

Skills and Experience

  • B.S. or M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Optical Engineering, or closely related field.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing precision opto-mechanical assemblies for production.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in tolerance stack-up analysis for optical alignment applications. Strong working knowledge of photonic component packaging (laser sources, PICs, fiber arrays, optical couplers).

  • Experience with thermally constrained mechanical design — CTE mismatch analysis, adhesive joint mechanics, and bonded dissimilar-material structures.

  • Proficiency in 3D CAD (Creo preferred) with GD&T to ASME Y14.5. Familiarity with precision machining, MIM, EDM, laser micromachining, and optical bonding processes.

  • Comfort with basic FEA tools for structural and thermal validation Green or Black Belt certification preferred

Compensation & Equity

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location.

  • Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You’re not just joining the mission; you’re owning a piece of it.

  • Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer a £24k annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office.

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates’ eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.

About ImagineArt

We're redefining how the world creates and designs.

ImagineArt is one of the fastest-growing GenAI companies in the world. We've scaled faster than most funded startups — with zero outside funding.

  • $35M+ ARR crossed this year

Why This Role Matters

  • You'll help define how ImagineArt turns product adoption into enterprise revenue

  • You'll work directly with founders and company leadership

Compensation & Benefits

title: Senior Product Manager, Data Foundry
original_description:
ABOUT BEAMERY

With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies.

We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all.

What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: 

Deepening our native integrations with SAP, Workday, Microsoft, and LinkedIn to seamlessly embed our skills intelligence into the platforms where critical workforce decisions are made.

Embedding our agentic AI to help customers plan smarter for the future—powering workforce strategies, internal mobility, and skills forecasting.

Advancing our use of proprietary LLMs and knowledge graph technology to help organizations unlock broader talent pools, make fairer decisions, and expand access to opportunity at scale.

But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work.

About the opportunity at Beamery

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Beamery's Data Foundry end to end. The Data Foundry is Beamery's proprietary data platform that powers existing and emerging product lines, including the Talent CRM and Workforce Suite, and provides data-as-a-service to customers through channels such as MCP/API as an emerging commercial channel. Its core capabilities span the data models, taxonomies and integrations that underpin talent and workforce decisions across the platform.

You will treat data both as infrastructure embedded within our products and as a product that customers buy in its own right. Beyond internal embedding and direct commercial sales, the platform is open — customers and partners can build on top of it through MCP and API access. You will work with product leadership to set the strategy, agree what the platform provides internally, decide what becomes customer-facing, and define how the platform opens up for customer and partner innovation.

You will work at the centre of the platform. On one side you serve the Talent CRM and Workforce Suite product managers as your customers, agreeing the data contracts they build on. On the other you partner with the data science, data engineering and integrations engineering leads to turn those needs into delivery.

What you will be doing

Ownership and strategy

  • Own the Data Foundry vision, strategy and roadmap, framing each item as a bet with a clear driver, aligned to overall strategic objectives

  • Ensure alignment of Data Foundry strategy to Beamery's AI strategy, reflecting the shift from providing AI assistants to providing AI access through MCP and API channels.

  • Decide what Data Foundry provides as internal infrastructure and what is packaged and sold as a customer-facing product.

  • Make and defend build versus buy decisions across integrations, analytics, AI and taxonomy capabilities.

Discovery and commercial impact

  • Discover and validate what external customers want from data-as-a-service, and partner with Sales and Customer Success to drive adoption with clear GTM and enablement plans

  • Build the case for Data Foundry as a new commercial channel, defining and proving the standalone commercial model alongside its role as platform foundation, quantify the value it unlocks for specific customers and deals, and measure success against value and usage metrics.

Partnership and delivery

  • Lead your team to deliver solutions our customers can’t imagine working without and that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes

  • Agree and maintain the data contracts with the CRM and Workforce Suite product managers, treating them as internal customers with real commitments.

  • Prioritise across data science, data engineering and integrations engineering, translating tribe needs into a clear and deliverable plan.

Communication & alignment

  • Communicate transparently and create alignment between peers and leadership on priorities, trade offs and progress

  • Manage customer and sales expectations through well managed structured cadences

Data governance and trust

  • Own how workforce data is governed, secured and access-controlled as it is exposed through APIs and MCP, meeting enterprise privacy and compliance expectations.

  • Ensure the outputs of Data Foundry's models are measurable and explainable, so customers and internal teams can trust and act on the results.

What we are looking for

  • A product manager experienced in complex technical, data or AI products, ideally in enterprise B2B SaaS.

  • Strong grasp of data platforms, APIs and integrations, comfortable making architecture-adjacent decisions with engineering and data science leads.

  • Experience handling sensitive or regulated data, with a clear view of governance, security and privacy.

  • An analytical thinker who uses data to find opportunities, prioritise and measure success.

  • A confident prioritiser who can balance competing tribe roadmaps and internal customers without losing direction.

  • Commercially fluent, able to connect product decisions to revenue, cost and customer ROI.

  • A clear communicator who builds trust across product, data science and engineering, and who is comfortable taking a position and explaining the reasoning.

  • Genuinely interested in how AI is reshaping the talent and workforce space, and in giving customers trusted, explainable access to their data.

Beamery is for Everybody. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to us. We acknowledge the challenges in our industry and strive to develop an inclusive culture where everybody can contribute. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, national origin, age, disability status, or caregiver status. If, for whatever reason, you need us to make reasonable adjustments and adaptations to our recruitment process, please email Visit our Diversity, Equality and Inclusion page to learn more about progress and commitments.

  • Design and iterate AI agent workflows to automate prospecting, outreach, lead qualification, and follow-up

  • Leverage LLM-powered tools to build scalable, autonomous product ops processes (e.g. customer and market feedback ops, roadmap and planning, process and governance, internal communication and team enablement)

  • Instrument agents with feedback loops and quality controls

  • Evaluate emerging AI tooling and document agent architectures so workflows are reproducible and maintainable

What we're looking for

  • Strong SQL. You'll be writing it daily, against messy real-world data, and you should be comfortable doing so as a stand-alone SME.

  • A track record in product analytics, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally somewhere with multiple products or a reasonably complex data model.

  • Hands-on experience with Pendo or a comparable product analytics tool (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Heap), and with a SQL-based exploration tool like Hex, Mode, or similar.

  • You can tell a clear story with data such as building a dashboard that doesn't need a tour, or present a finding to a PM or a VP with strong clarity and focus.

  • Pragmatism. Beamery's data isn't pristine. We need someone who can make progress in a real environment in the face of imperfect conditions.

  • Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-powered automation workflows - either in a business or personal context

Nice to have

  • Experience analysing AI/ML-powered product features.

  • Exposure to HR tech, talent acquisition, or workforce data.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
original_description:
AI is being run everywhere, by humans and agents. Harmonic Security governs all of it. The AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform understands user / agent intent and data context in real time, giving security teams visibility and control across every tool and workflow so companies can move faster with AI while minimizing risk.

We operate in one of the fastest-moving spaces in tech: the emerging intersection of AI and cybersecurity. It's a market still being defined, and we're among the first to build natively for it - protecting sensitive data in real time, at the endpoint, with minimal friction for the teams using it. Enterprises get full visibility and control. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

Named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, Harmonic is gaining serious recognition and serious traction. We're led by deep cybersecurity expertise and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel.

As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

How We Work: AI-First by Design

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work — from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity.

For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive.

About the Team

Our Product Delivery team is the engine that turns vision into impact. We ship early and often, getting valuable features into the hands of customers quickly and iterating from there. We work in the open by default, sharing progress and ideas, and we trust each other to own outcomes. We’re a small but mighty crew where every person plays a critical role and we’re committed to using AI to work smarter and faster.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer who has an appreciation for all things security and system interconnectivity. This is a very hands-on technical role where you will be responsible for designing, building and maintaining scalable integrations between our core applications, identity providers and data security platforms.

What You'll Do

  • Own deliveries and features from start to finish

  • Design, build, and own backend services in a microservices-based, event-driven architecture

  • Implement core domain logic that drives key product workflows and system behavior

  • Ingest and process high-volume usage and event data from customer-facing endpoints

  • Build backend services that support operational, analytics, and reporting use cases

  • Model, persist, and manage domain data, enabling querying, filtering, and lifecycle management

  • Expose well-designed APIs and webhooks consumed by customers, UIs, and external systems

  • Power customer-facing UI experiences by providing backend APIs for visibility, analytics, and configuration

What You Bring

  • 3–5+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend services and distributed systems in the Java ecosystem (Java, Spring Boot, Maven/Gradle)

  • Strong understanding of event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing patterns, messaging systems, and distributed system design

  • Proven experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs, web hooks, and service-to-service integrations

  • Comfortable operating in AWS, GCP, or Azure environments and working with modern observability tooling, logging, and monitoring platforms

  • A track record of delivering performant, reliable and scalable applications

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills in cross-functional teams

You Might Be a Fit if You

  • Have experience building products in cybersecurity, identity, governance, compliance, data protection, or enterprise SaaS environments

  • You understand not just how to build systems, but why architectural decisions matter

  • You can balance scalability, reliability, maintainability, and speed of execution

  • You think critically about security, observability, and operational excellence from day one

  • Love the idea of blending software development, distributed systems and data-intensive applications

  • Strong familiarity with authentication and identity technologies such as OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, SCIM, Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, or other enterprise identity providers

  • Thrive in fast-paced startup environments where ambiguity is the norm

  • Enjoy shaping culture and engineering practices, not just writing code

  • Leverage AI tools as an engineer to help you build smarter, faster and better

Why Join Us

This isn't just a job - it's a chance to help define a category. Harmonic Security was named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, and we're just getting started. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, carving out an emerging market where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

We believe today's talent is tomorrow's success, and we're committed to creating an environment where you can do the best work of your life.

  • Recognized momentum - We made the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, a signal that the market is taking notice

  • Rare market opportunity - Join early in a category-defining company at the convergence of AI and security, where your work directly shapes how enterprises tackle one of the biggest unsolved problems in tech

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity - A real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture

  • Comprehensive benefits - 401K, pension plan, generous PTO, and flexible hybrid work

  • A small, high-trust team that values transparency, creativity, and continuous learning - no politics, no bureaucracy

  • Thoughtful leadership - that cares deeply about your growth, not just your output

  • Annual global off-sites - past trips include Lisbon, Portugal and Nashville, TN

  • Real ownership - you'll shape the product, the culture, and the direction of the company from day one

Harmonic's Core Values

🌱 Flourish in the Unknown

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

🔥 Never Full

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.

🤝 Perfect Harmony

We support one another to create cohesion and unity. We collaborate openly, share feedback honestly, and help everyone produce their best work

Compensation: £98K – £110K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

  • London, England • £98K – £110K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Senior Software Security Engineer
original_description:
AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it.

Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in under 200ms. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

How We Work: AI-First by Design

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work — from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity.

For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive.

About the Team

Our Product Delivery team is the engine that turns vision into impact. We ship early and often, getting valuable features into the hands of customers quickly and iterating fast. We work in the open by default, sharing progress and ideas, and we trust each other to own outcomes. We’re a small but mighty crew where every person plays a critical role and we’re committed to using AI to work smarter and faster.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Security Engineer to become the authority on our platform's security architecture - and to write the code that embodies it. You'll inherit a platform where the fundamentals of authentication and authorization, secrets and key management, encryption, and multi-tenant data isolation are established, and your job is to sharpen, harden, and evolve them with the depth a dedicated specialist brings that a generalist team can't. You will establish standards and enable the rest of the team to adhere to them. You'll spend the majority of your time writing production code, not producing reports on someone else's.

This is deliberately not a role for someone who wants to sit on a security team finding holes in what other people have already shipped. We want someone who'd rather build the fix into the architecture in the first place - hands-on, opinionated, and accountable for the outcome.

What You'll Do

  • Take formal ownership of Harmonic's platform security architecture - authentication and authorization, secrets and key management, encryption at rest and in transit, and multi-tenant data isolation - and evolve it beyond what a generalist engineering team has had the focus to do

  • Write production code using our existing languages and tooling (primarily Java, Terraform also Typescript, Rust, Python) to harden and extends these patterns in our core platform.

  • Collaborate closely with the platform team, who own our architecture and engineering standards, so that security standards are woven into that shared framework rather than sitting alongside it - you'll shape architectural decisions together, not hand requirements over the fence

  • Manage your own backlog of platform security improvements, prioritized independently of the product roadmap

  • Run threat modeling and architecture reviews on major new systems and integrations before they ship, so security is designed in rather than retrofitted

  • Create a close partnership with the Security team to provide evidence that we are adhering to required standards and ensure they are informed where we go beyond

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep specialization in security architecture rather than general backend development

  • Strong working knowledge of Java, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and/or OpenTofu

  • Experience with AWS and its security fundamentals - IAM, network security, container and secrets management.

  • Strong grounding in threat modeling and secure-by-design principles, applied to real architectural decisions rather than theoretical frameworks

  • Comfort setting technical standards that other engineers are expected to follow, with the communication skill to bring people along rather than dictate from a distance

You Might Be a Fit if You

  • Have built or hardened platform-level security in a SaaS company that faces serious enterprise scrutiny (SOC 2, ISO 27001, customer security questionnaires, or similar)

  • Would rather build the fix into the architecture than find the next hole in someone else's code

  • Have no patience for security theatre - you measure success by real, shipped improvements to our security posture, not policies, paperwork, or box-ticking that only looks like progress

  • Leverage AI tools as an engineer to help you build smarter, faster and better

  • Enjoy being the go-to authority on a topic and setting the standard, rather than gatekeeping other people's work

  • Are comfortable being the first specialist in this seat, inheriting a solid foundation and having the autonomy - and responsibility - to take it further

  • Thrive in fast-paced startup environments where ambiguity is the norm

Why Join Us

We're still small enough that every hire changes the company.

If you're looking for a role where you can build, make decisions, and have a real impact, you'll find that here. You'll work closely with experienced leaders, help shape how we scale, and have a direct hand in building the kind of company people want to work at.

  • Recognized momentum — named to Rising in Cyber 2026, a signal the market is taking notice

  • Rare market opportunity — join early in a category-defining company shaping how enterprises tackle one of tech's biggest unsolved problems

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity — a real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture

  • Comprehensive benefits — 401K/pension, generous PTO, flexible hybrid work

  • A small, high-trust team — transparency, creativity, continuous learning, no politics, no bureaucracy

  • Thoughtful leadership that cares about your growth, not just your output

  • Annual global off-sites — past trips include Lisbon and Nashville

  • Real ownership — you'll shape the platform, the culture, and the direction of the company from day one

Harmonic's Core Values

🌱 Flourish in the Unknown

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

🔥 Never Full

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.

🤝 Perfect Harmony

We support one another to create cohesion and unity. We collaborate openly, share feedback honestly, and help everyone produce their best work

Compensation: £98K – £115K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

  • London, England • £98K – £115K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Business Intelligence & GTM AI Associate
original_description:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

🔍 What will you be doing?

Own Primer's GTM intelligence layer
Maintain and continuously improve the dashboards and data models at the core of how our GTM teams operate and make decisions. You'll identify gaps, build new views, and ensure the data our teams rely on is accurate, trusted, and acted upon - not just looked at.

Keep the AI in our BI sharp
Continuously train and improve our BI tool’s (Omni) AI model so that natural-language queries, whether through Omni directly or via Claude, return accurate, contextually aware results. You are the steward of how well our BI tool thinks.

Partner with data engineering to optimise performance, and build what's missing
Own and maintain the semantic data layer and transformation logic so that dashboards are fast, consistent, and built on a foundation that scales. Identify where missing data sources are limiting GTM intelligence and work with the data engineering team to build the pipelines that close those gaps. You understand the data landscape end-to-end and can make a clear case for what needs to be optimised or built.

Surface pipeline and account intelligence
Build models and dashboards that go beyond historical reporting - surfacing engagement signals, account health indicators, and expansion opportunities that help GTM reps prioritise the right actions at the right time. Partner with data engineering and product ops to embed analytic events across Primer's web and dashboard environments, capturing user and intent signals that bring a new layer of behavioural intelligence into GTM.

Model Salesforce data correctly
Ensure CRM data is well-structured, correctly modelled, and fully leveraged in reporting. Work with RevOps and GTM leadership to make sure what lives in Salesforce is trusted, clean, and meaningful, so that any reporting built on top of it actually reflects reality.

Build models that drive revenue decisions
Partner with RevOps to develop data models that calculate potential ROI for prospects evaluating Primer products, and build the forecasting infrastructure that improves the accuracy of payment volume and revenue projections.

Own the GTM data foundation
Define and maintain field definitions, naming conventions, and data quality standards across the GTM tech stack. Good AI starts with good data, and good data starts with clear governance.

Build the AI context layer for GTM
Create and maintain the shared knowledge infrastructure that gives AI tools, including Claude, the right context to produce high-quality outputs. You'll build and curate the GTM knowledge base that sits behind our AI.

Build GTM AI workflows, with Claude at the core
Work with GTM stakeholders, and Primer’s AI Strategy & Enablement Lead to spot processes where in-house AI workflows, skills and artifacts unlock real self-serve value. Build the more complex workflows hands-on, and upskill others to build the simpler ones themselves. Since Claude is central to AI at Primer, this includes enabling connectors to key business tools and building the skills that make Claude genuinely useful in a GTM role.

Own adoption and impact, not just the build
Shipping something is the start, not the finish. You own the rollout until it sticks, partnering with GTM Enablement on training and documentation so it lands inside existing enablement programmes rather than as a one-off. Collect feedback, iterate, and track and report on GTM AI use cases and their measurable impact.

Promote self-serve data literacy
Coach GTM stakeholders to explore data autonomously. Build the education and support that turns Omni from something people request help with into something they reach for themselves.

Stay ahead of the AI landscape
Proactively assess new AI tools and new features in Primer's existing tech stack. Make clear recommendations on what to adopt, pilot, or ignore. Ensure we're extracting full value from what we already pay for.

👀 What we’d love to see

Solid data and analytics foundation
3-5 years of experience in a data analytics, BI, or revenue operations role. You're comfortable working with complex datasets, building dashboards, and communicating what the numbers mean - without needing someone else to pull the data for you.

SQL proficiency
You write SQL fluently. Joins, window functions, aggregations - you can interrogate a data warehouse directly and know how to model data correctly, not just query it.

Hands-on AI experience
You use AI tools in your daily work, have built workflows or automations using LLMs, and understand enough about how they work to make them reliably useful rather than impressively unreliable.

Strong understanding of APIs and MCPs
You know how to retrieve data from APIs, trigger actions via them, and think in terms of integrations. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you're comfortable operating at the boundary between data and tooling.

CRM data experience
You understand how Salesforce (or similar CRM) data is structured, where it tends to go wrong, and how to model it for reliable reporting and AI consumption.

Clear communicator with a coaching instinct
You can explain data and AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders clearly, and you care about building their capability - not just doing it for them.

High autonomy in ambiguous environments
You don't wait for the problem to be fully defined. You identify the opportunity, make a case for it, and go build it.

✅ Nice to have

Payments or fintech experience
Familiarity with the metrics, data models, and commercial dynamics of a payments or B2B SaaS business.

Experience with dbt, Snowflake or similar data tooling
You've worked alongside or within data engineering pipelines and understand how data gets from source to warehouse.

Python or scripting proficiency
Useful for data manipulation, automation, and building lightweight AI tools beyond what SQL alone can handle.

Omni or comparable BI tool experience
You've worked with a modern BI tool and understand how to get the best out of its AI layer.

Prompt engineering practice
You have a structured approach to prompt design and can teach others how to improve the quality of their AI interactions.

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one
💰 Competitive share options
🌴 Uncapped holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken
🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat
💻 The best equipment for your role
🏠 £500 towards your home office setup
🔎 Generous learning budget
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Primer is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and adopts a zero-tolerance approach to discrimination, regardless of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other background or belief.

title: Bid & Contracts Manager
original_description:
Bid & Contracts Manager

The Role

Lyrebird is scaling fast - more NHS Trusts, more enterprise health tech partners, and more complexity in every tender, contract, and framework we touch. This role sits at the centre of that growth: you'll be the person who turns opportunities into signed, well-structured commercial agreements, and who keeps our contractual house in order as we grow. title: Product Designer
original_description:
About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

The Context

The design team at Plasma is small by choice. Two senior designers currently cover the whole of Plasma One, from core money movement flows through to the design system. You would be the third.

Design is a first-class input here. It shapes product direction, technical tradeoffs, and whether people trust us with their money.

You would help decide how design actually works: how decisions get made, how work is reviewed, how quality holds up under speed, and how a coherent system takes shape as the product grows. There is no process to inherit and no large team to hide inside. What you build becomes the standard.

The team works closely with engineering and the growth team. Designers at Plasma are expected to think in systems, understand real constraints, and push for clarity where ambiguity is expensive. The bar is high, feedback is direct, and the impact is visible quickly.

This suits someone who wants autonomy and responsibility, who wants to build the product that changes how money moves, and the team behind it.

The Work

  • Own the Plasma experience. Invent new features and shape how Plasma One feels to use, taking ideas from concept to launch. Turn the advantages of stablecoins and blockchain into experiences that make people’s financial lives better.

  • Extend your abilities with AI. Use AI as a core tool to explore more ambitious ideas, build functional prototypes, and push what you can design and deliver.

  • Bring ideas to life. Turn abstract concepts into working coded prototypes, then collaborate with engineers who share your attention to detail to bring them into production. Refine microinteractions, motion, and visual polish together.

  • Evolve the design system. Build reusable components and interaction patterns that keep the product coherent as it grows, with design and implementation aligned.

  • Learn from real use. Combine research, usability testing, and product data to discover opportunities and improve what you ship.



The Bar

  • Substantial consumer product experience. Typically 6+ years in product design, including shipped native iOS and/or Android work and meaningful contributions to a design system.

  • A portfolio with exceptional craft. Show us the details you refined, the reasoning behind them, and your contribution to the finished product. We want to understand your taste and how you decide when an experience is ready.

  • Confidence with functional prototyping. You can make an idea tangible enough to test its behaviour and communicate the intended experience to engineers. Understanding or writing code is a bonus, not a requirement.

  • Sound product judgment. You can explain how user evidence changed a decision, what you chose to prioritise, and what happened after launch. You are comfortable making progress when the brief is incomplete.

  • Direct, thoughtful collaboration. You make your reasoning easy to follow, give specific feedback, and can disagree constructively. You know when to work independently and when to bring others into a decision.

What's in it for you

  • Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation.

  • A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad.

  • Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.

  • Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.

  • All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.

  • Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

Data Protection & Privacy
We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws.

original_description:
About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

  • Consumer owns the core Plasma One product experience - onboarding, activation, retention, rewards, tiers, trading, earn, and account management. The team is responsible for growing funded users, engagement, balances, spend, and long-term retention.

  • Payments owns the financial infrastructure that powers Plasma - accounts, ledgers, funding, payouts, card issuing, reconciliation, payment orchestration, and currency/rail integrations. The team is responsible for the reliability, scalability, and economics of moving and storing money.

  • Business owns the Plasma experience for companies - the operating account for businesses that work globally: onboarding, receiving, holding, and sending money across borders, corporate cards and spend management, and the roles and approvals that keep teams in control of company money. The team is responsible for taking the product from its first business customers to general availability, and for growing the businesses that run on Plasma.

The Role

We're looking for a staff+ engineer, backend-leaning but comfortable full-stack, to join one of Plasma's engineering teams and take ownership of that team's hardest technical problems. Our stack is TypeScript across the board - Node.js on the backend and React + React Native for the frontend

You are expected to set technical direction for your team's most critical systems, while partnering with product and, where relevant, other teams at the points where your systems connect.

The Work

  • Own the hardest technical problems inside your team end to end - the ones that need deep judgment, not just execution.

  • Set technical direction for your team's core systems: architecture, data models, and standards that hold up as the team scales.

  • Design for reliability first: idempotency, consistency, and graceful failure recovery in systems that move or store real money, or that the network depends on.

  • Go deep on the backend, but stay full-stack, own the TypeScript service and the data model, and work through the client or API layer when the problem calls for it.

  • Define how your team's systems handle the hard edge cases: partial failures, retries, timeouts, reversals, reconciliation gaps - whatever “correct under pressure” means for your team.

  • Contribute, architect and improve the frontend systems and integrations wherever necessary

  • Raise the technical bar within your team: code standards, testing strategy, monitoring, incident response, and how the team approaches ambiguous problems.

  • Mentor other engineers and drive technical clarity on the hardest parts of your team's system.

The Bar

  • A staff-level, hands-on engineer with a track record of owning production systems end to end, not just contributing to them.

  • Backend-leaning but full-stack: deep expertise building backend services in TypeScript (Node.js), with enough range to work through the client layer when needed.

  • Strong instincts around reliability and correctness - you think in systems: state machines, data integrity, observability, operational risk.

  • Comfortable taking systems from zero to one, and then scaling them without losing clarity.

  • Strong judgment on tradeoffs: speed vs. safety, abstraction vs. control, simplicity vs. flexibility.

  • You communicate clearly, write clean code, and can lead through technical decisions without needing to manage people.

  • You have very high agency and don’t wait to be told a problem to work on and proactively find new problems to solve

  • You make decisions based on data and use data to ground whether solutions work

Nice to have

  • Fintech, banking, or crypto-native background.

  • Familiarity with stablecoins, custody, settlement, and blockchain transaction lifecycles.

  • You’ve been a founder or early employee at a fast-paced, high agency startup

What's in it for you

  • Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation.

  • A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad.

  • Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.

  • Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.

  • All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.

  • Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

Data Protection & Privacy
We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws.

title: Scientist I
original_description:
About IMU Biosciences

IMU Biosciences has developed proprietary platform technologies that generate and translate vast system-level immune data into actionable insights and tools to drive the development of precision medicines across a variety of diseases. Built on over a decade of research at King’s College London and the Francis Crick Institute, IMU leverages advanced immune profiling with proprietary AI and machine learning analytics to uncover novel clinical immune signatures. IMU continues to establish partnerships with leading pharma and biotech companies to advance disease diagnosis, optimise product selection, and improve patient stratification and monitoring - while also building its own pipeline of innovative products.

As a Scientist I at IMU Biosciences, you will be embedded in the wet lab platform team and work closely with other scientists to generate high-quality, reproducible data, providing a new perspective on human immunology. You will be responsible for the day-to-day operation of the next-gen spectral flow and single cell genomics IMU platform.

The Role

We are seeking a Scientist I to join our laboratory platform team and support the generation of high-quality, reproducible immunology data.

This is a hands-on, lab-based role focused on the day-to-day operation of our immune profiling platform, including spectral flow cytometry and single-cell genomics workflows.

You will work closely with a collaborative team of scientists and contribute to both routine assay execution and the ongoing development of platform capabilities.

Due to the nature of the work this role requires working in the lab on a Saturday approximately 1 in every 4 weeks – time off in lieu and overtime pay will be provided. This is organised on a rota basis with other members of the lab team.

 
 

Key Responsibilities

Assay Execution & Data Generation

  • Perform immune phenotyping and functional assays, including high-parameter flow cytometry

  • Isolate and process human blood and tissue samples

  • Prepare samples for single-cell sequencing workflows

  • Support data handling, documentation, and storage in line with internal standards

Laboratory Operations & Quality

  • Maintain and adhere to laboratory quality control processes

  • Perform routine instrument QC checks and basic troubleshooting

  • Ensure accurate execution of SOPs and contribute to maintaining high data quality

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work collaboratively across the lab team to support multiple concurrent projects

  • Communicate progress clearly and proactively, contributing updates, ideas, and feedback

  • Support coordination of sample receipt and logistics with external partners

Laboratory Support

  • Contribute to general lab operations, including reagent preparation, stock management, and equipment upkeep

  • Ensure samples, reagents, and materials are handled, stored, and tracked appropriately

Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to optimisation of workflows and identification of new techniques or technologies to improve efficiency and reproducibility

 
 

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

Essential

  • BSc or MSc in a relevant biological science, with hands-on laboratory experience

  • Strong practical experience in flow cytometry (minimum 15 colour panels)

  • Experience working with human blood and/or tissue samples to isolate immune cells, eg PBMCs

  • High level of attention to detail and commitment to data quality and reproducibility

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities

  • Proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team

  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to troubleshoot experimental challenges

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Flexibility to accommodate time-sensitive sample workflows when required

Desirable

  • Knowledge of human immunology and immune phenotyping approaches

  • Experience with spectral flow cytometry

  • Exposure to single-cell genomics workflows

  • Experience designing or optimising experiments

  • Familiarity with LIMS/ELN systems

  • Understanding of regulated lab environments (e.g. ISO 15189, ISO 13485)

  • Experience in a biotech or pharmaceutical setting

 
 

Why Join IMU Biosciences?

  • Work on cutting-edge science in immune profiling and precision medicine

  • Be part of a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary team

  • Gain exposure to advanced technologies (spectral flow + single cell)

  • Join a fast-growing biotech at an early and impactful stage

  • Opportunity to develop and grow alongside the company

 
 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonus scheme

  • Pension, health insurance, life assurance, and income protection

  • Fast-paced, collaborative startup culture

  • Strong opportunities for career development and progression

title: Software Engineer
original_description:
About IMU Biosciences

IMU Biosciences has developed proprietary platform technologies that generate and translate vast system-level immune data into actionable insights and tools to drive the development of precision medicines across a variety of diseases. Built on over a decade of research at King’s College London and the Francis Crick Institute, IMU leverages advanced immune profiling with proprietary AI and machine learning analytics to uncover novel clinical immune signatures. IMU continues to establish partnerships with leading pharma and biotech companies to advance disease diagnosis, optimise product selection, and improve patient stratification and monitoring - while also building its own pipeline of innovative products.

About the role

IMU is applying cutting-edge immune system science, data engineering, and machine learning to understand human health in a deeper and more actionable way. As our work moves closer to the clinic, we are building the data infrastructure needed to make complex biological and clinical data reliable, reproducible, governed, and ready for scientific discovery.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to help build and operate the platform behind that work. We think of the data platform as a product, not just infrastructure: it should be reliable, usable, well-documented, and shaped around the needs of the scientists, data scientists, and engineers who depend on it.

You will help turn high-dimensional biological data into trusted, reusable, analysis-ready data products, and you will build the infrastructure that allows teams to run reproducible pipelines at scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who lives in the cloud, expects infrastructure to be defined as code, and cares deeply about reproducibility. The work connects modern data platform engineering directly to cutting-edge science and, ultimately, better human health.

The role is hybrid, with an expectation of working from our London office a couple of days per week.

Team and ways of working

You will join a small, growing data platform function working closely with computational immunologists, data scientists, software engineers, and clinical-facing teams. This role sits in the platform layer: building the shared foundations that allow project teams to ingest, structure, govern, process, and reuse data reliably.

You will not be working in isolation, but you should be comfortable owning substantial pieces of the platform, making pragmatic technical decisions, and helping set engineering standards as the function scales.

What you will do

  • Build, maintain, and improve cloud-native data platform services used by scientific, data science, and engineering teams.

  • Develop and operate data lake and medallion-style architectures across raw, cleaned, curated, and analysis-ready data layers.

  • Create reliable patterns for data ingestion, validation, transformation, storage, metadata capture, and access control.

  • Support reproducible scientific and data pipelines, including assisting in the migration of workflows into production-ready deployable artefacts.

  • Improve data discoverability, lineage, provenance, auditability, and reuse in line with practical FAIR data principles.

  • Build automation, infrastructure, and developer workflows using infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, containers, and cloud-native engineering practices.

  • Work closely with scientists, software engineers, and platform users to turn real data problems into reliable platform capabilities.

  • Improve reliability, documentation, maintainability, and cost-awareness across data platform services and pipelines.

What we are looking for

Core experience

We do not expect every candidate to have used every tool in our stack. At CV stage, we are mainly looking for evidence of strong engineering judgement and hands-on experience in a few key areas:

  • Strong software engineering experience in Python or another production-grade language.

  • Practical experience building and operating cloud-native systems on AWS.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, ideally Pulumi, Terraform, or an equivalent tool.

  • Experience with data lakes, medallion architectures, lakehouse patterns, or large-scale analytical data platforms.

  • Experience enabling, operating, or productionising data pipelines or scientific workflows.

Technologies we use or value highly

The closer your experience is to this stack, the faster you are likely to be productive, but we care more about depth and judgement than superficial exposure to every tool:

  • AWS

  • Pulumi, Terraform, or equivalent infrastructure-as-code

  • GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD

  • SQLMesh or equivalent SQL-based transformation, modelling, testing, and deployment framework

  • Containers and modern DevOps practices

  • Data lakes, object storage, metadata, validation, schema management, and data lifecycle patterns

  • FAIR data principles, lineage, provenance, and governance

Nice to have

  • Experience with Seqera Platform and Nextflow for reproducible scientific workflow execution.

  • Experience with Dagster or Snowflake.

  • Experience in scientific, bioinformatics, computational biology, immunology, clinical, healthcare, or other regulated data environments.

  • Experience with lakehouse technologies such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Databricks, Athena, Glue, Trino, Spark, or DuckDB.

  • Experience with regulated software, security, quality, or healthcare frameworks such as IEC 62304, ISO 27001, ISO 13485, HTA, HIPAA, or similar.

  • Experience building self-service data platforms, internal developer platforms, or platform capabilities for data science teams.

What success looks like

You will help make the data platform a dependable foundation for scientific discovery and decision-making. Success means data is easier to find, easier to trust, easier to reuse, and easier to process reproducibly.

Scientific and data teams should be able to spend less time fighting infrastructure, tracing data provenance, or manually moving data between systems, and more time generating insight.

Why join us

IMU is building a company around a big scientific idea: that a deeper, data-driven understanding of the immune system can change how we understand, monitor, and ultimately improve human health.

We work with rich, complex biological data and combine scientific expertise, machine learning, and modern data infrastructure to generate insight from the immune system. Our work is moving closer to the clinic, which means the platform we build now has to support both rapid discovery and the discipline needed for future clinical and regulated use.

This is a rare opportunity to join at the point where the foundations are still being shaped. You will not be maintaining a legacy estate or simply keeping dashboards alive. You will help define how data is structured, governed, processed, discovered, and reused across the organisation.

The team is collaborative, scientifically curious, and pragmatic. We value strong engineering, clear ownership, sensible architecture, and people who can work effectively across disciplines while staying focused on practical delivery and real scientific outcomes.

You will also have room to grow. The data platform is central to IMU's future, so this role offers the chance to influence technical direction, shape engineering standards, and build systems that can scale with the company as we move from discovery toward clinical impact.

We support hybrid working, with time in our London office a couple of days per week, and flexibility around how people do their best work.

title: VP Sales, Europe
original_description:
VP Sales Europe

Based out of the UK.

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our product alleviates administrative inefficiencies and observational tasks that overburden healthcare professionals, enabling them to provide better patient care.

Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI, and desktop and mobile applications, Teton helps create a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real-time data insights, creating a digital twin of resident states and care delivery that empowers healthcare providers with actionable intelligence for optimal decision-making.

With strong demand and clear product-market fit, Teton is focused on scaling its presence across Europe. We operate through a Country Director model across three established territories - the Nordics (Copenhagen), UK&I (London), and the DACH region (Zurich) - selling into both public hospital systems and care home operators. This is a rare opportunity to lead an established multi-country commercial organisation, bring consistency and governance across territories, and open Teton’s next European markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop Teton’s European sales organisation in the Nordics, UK&I, and DACH, holding each territory accountable to its new business targets.

  • Own and optimise Teton’s European commercial operating cadence across pipeline generation, tender and bid qualification, deal progression, forecasting, CRM governance, performance management, and team accountability - creating a consistent governance structure across territories while respecting local market differences.

  • Act as a hands-on deal leader on Europe's largest opportunities, across both public tenders and complex private enterprise deals - joining critical customer meetings, site visits, and executive presentations to bring deals over the line.

  • Optimise go-to-market in each territory: segmentation, coverage model, territory design, resourcing, and partner strategy across public hospital systems and private and public care home operators.

  • Evaluate and open new core European markets, such as the Benelux region - building the market-entry case, the operating model, and the initial commercial footprint.

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop commercial leadership and talent as Europe scales, while raising the effectiveness of the existing teams.

  • Represent Teton at major European industry conferences, national associations, while helping refine go-to-market strategy, messaging, pricing, and commercial execution across the region.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience selling and leading teams that sell large and complex contracts won through public sector tenders and RFPs - a genuine command of the public procurement motion is essential for this role.

  • Equivalent enterprise experience closing large, complex contracts with private organisations, as both motions exist across Teton’s European territories.

  • A demonstrated track record as a highly successful individual contributor, consistently exceeding significant new business quotas and closing complex, high six-figure ACV opportunities across long sales cycles.

  • Proven sales leadership experience managing, coaching, and developing sales leaders and net-new business teams carrying significant new business quotas, ideally across multiple European countries or territories.

  • The ability to operate as a true player-coach: strategic enough to optimise the sales organisation and operating model, but hands-on enough to actively influence and close critical deals.

  • Deep experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving executive buyers, procurement, legal, and ownership groups.

  • A rigorous, data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, CRM accuracy, qualification, performance management, and sales governance.

  • Experience building or scaling sales teams, segmentation models, territories, processes, methodologies, and repeatable go-to-market motions, including entering new markets.

  • Exposure to healthcare, hospital systems or senior living is a strong bonus, but not a requirement.

  • 12+ years in enterprise sales, with at least 5 of those spent leading sales teams.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with a willingness to travel regularly across Europe.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and participation in our warrant program.

  • Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A high-impact leadership position with significant influence over Teton’s European go-to-market strategy, territory structure, and commercial execution.

  • A vibrant, learning-focused work environment
