title: US Marketing Lead
original_description:
US Marketing Lead

Location: United States

Reports to: VP of Marketing

Employment type: Full-time

About Teton

Teton is building the autonomous operating system for care. Our technology gives senior living and care teams greater visibility into resident wellbeing, movement, sleep, and care delivery, helping them respond faster, work more efficiently, and provide more personalized care.

We are growing quickly across the United States and are looking for a US Marketing Lead to own our regional marketing strategy and execution.

The Role

The US Marketing Lead will be the territory owner for Teton’s growth and brand presence in the United States.

You will translate Teton’s global positioning and company priorities into a focused US marketing plan that creates demand, strengthens our reputation, and helps the sales team win. This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the regional strategy, build campaigns, produce sales materials, support events, coordinate PR, and measure what is working.

You will work closely with US Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Events, Growth, and external partners. You will report to the VP of Marketing and serve as the primary marketing partner for the US commercial team.

What You’ll Own

US Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute the US marketing plan in alignment with company revenue goals and global marketing priorities.

  • Identify the audiences, markets, partnerships, and channels most likely to drive growth.

  • Adapt Teton’s global campaigns and positioning for the US senior living and care market.

  • Maintain a clear regional campaign calendar, budget, and set of priorities.

  • Bring insights from customers, prospects, competitors, and the market back into the broader marketing organization.

Demand Generation and Campaigns

  • Partner with Growth Lead to build and run integrated campaigns across email, paid media, content, webinars, events, partnerships, and other relevant channels.

  • Create campaigns around Teton’s most important customer problems and product capabilities.

  • Own regional email strategy, segmentation, nurture programs, and campaign follow-up.

  • Work with Growth to improve lead generation, conversion, and account engagement.

  • Develop targeted programs for priority accounts, operator groups, and strategic market segments.

  • Ensure leads are properly captured, routed, followed up on, and measured in HubSpot.

Sales Enablement

  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to the US sales organization.

  • Develop and maintain US-specific sales decks, case studies, one-pagers, proposals, follow-up materials, and campaign assets.

  • Translate product capabilities into clear operational and commercial value for senior living operators.

  • Equip sales with the proof points, customer stories, and market insights needed to move opportunities forward.

  • Support account-based campaigns for strategic prospects and active opportunities.

  • Gather regular feedback from Sales and Customer Success to identify gaps in messaging, content, and enablement.

Events, Webinars, and Partnerships

  • Partner with the Events lead to determine which US conferences, webinars, executive gatherings, and field programs deserve investment.

  • Build pre-event, on-site, and post-event campaigns that generate meetings and measurable pipeline.

  • Support speaker submissions, presentations, sponsorships, customer participation, and event messaging.

  • Develop regional partnerships with associations, media organizations, technology partners, and other industry stakeholders.

  • Ensure events are connected to broader campaigns rather than treated as standalone activities.

Content, Customer Stories, and PR

  • Identify strong US customer stories and work with Customer Success to turn them into case studies, testimonials, videos, and campaign assets.

  • Develop content that reflects the priorities and language of US senior living operators.

  • Work with internal subject-matter experts to produce thought leadership, educational content, reports, and webinars.

  • Coordinate with Teton’s PR partners on announcements, contributed articles, awards, speaking opportunities, and media relationships.

  • Help establish Teton and its leadership as credible voices in the US senior living market.

Product Positioning and Market Intelligence

  • Localize global product positioning for US audiences while maintaining consistency with Teton’s overall narrative.

  • Develop messaging for different US customer segments, buyer roles, and stages of the sales process.

  • Monitor competitors, category trends, customer needs, and changes in the senior living market.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product to support launches and communicate new capabilities effectively.

  • Ensure US market feedback is reflected in future campaigns, content, and product messaging.

Measurement and Reporting

  • Define regional goals and report on campaign performance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, event results, and channel effectiveness.

  • Maintain clear dashboards and regular updates for Marketing and US commercial leadership.

  • Use performance data to improve targeting, messaging, campaign investment, and sales follow-up.

  • Establish a consistent process for evaluating what is working, what is not, and where the team should focus next.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will have:

  • Established a clear and credible US marketing strategy tied to Teton’s commercial goals.

  • Built a consistent campaign engine that generates qualified demand and supports pipeline growth.

  • Improved the quality and consistency of US sales enablement.

  • Created a repeatable approach to US events, webinars, partnerships, and account-based programs.

  • Expanded Teton’s library of US customer proof points and case studies.

  • Increased Teton’s visibility and credibility with senior living operators and industry stakeholders.

  • Created transparent reporting that shows how US marketing contributes to revenue.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in healthcare technology, senior living, or enterprise software industry.

  • Experience owning a regional, vertical, or business-unit marketing strategy.

  • A track record of building integrated campaigns that contribute to pipeline and revenue.

  • Strong sales enablement experience and the ability to work closely with enterprise sales teams.

  • Experience with events, content, email marketing, webinars, account-based marketing, and demand generation.

  • Excellent writing, editing, messaging, and presentation skills.

  • Strong project-management skills and the ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution.

  • Comfort working in a fast-growing company where priorities can change and processes are still being built.

  • Strong analytical judgment and experience using marketing and CRM data to make decisions.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and related marketing tools is preferred.

  • Knowledge of the US senior living or healthcare market is highly valuable.

The Person We Think Will Thrive

You are a strong generalist who knows how to turn company goals into focused regional execution. You can write a campaign brief, improve a sales deck, develop an event plan, interview a customer, analyze lead performance, and present a clear recommendation to leadership.

You are commercially minded, comfortable working directly with sales, and focused on producing work that helps the company grow. You bring structure without creating unnecessary process, and you know how to balance brand building with near-term pipeline needs.

title: FNOL Claims Handler
original_description:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Purpose of the role

First Notification of Loss is the first thing a customer experiences after an accident, and it sets the tone for everything that follows. In 18 months, every Zego customer reporting a loss will get an accurate, empathetic first contact and be routed to the right next step first time. You are the reason claims start clean, so the rest of the journey runs smoothly.

What you will be doing

  • Handle First Notification of Loss queries by phone, email and live chat with empathy, accuracy and efficiency.

  • Capture every relevant claim detail correctly at first contact, so nothing has to be chased again later.

  • Triage customers and route them to the right next step in their claims journey.

  • Leave customers feeling heard, supported and informed at a genuinely difficult moment.

  • Keep records in our claims management systems accurate, protecting data quality at every stage.

  • Work with the wider Claims team and supply chain partners so claims progress smoothly from the very first touchpoint.

What you will need to be successful

  • Call centre experience. You have worked in a call centre and in a fast paced environment. Insurance experience is not required.

  • Empathy under pressure. You communicate with clarity and warmth, especially when customers are in distress.

  • An eye for detail. You get the facts right and build rapport quickly over the phone.

  • Prioritisation at volume. You can multitask, set priorities and manage your time in a high volume contact centre.

  • Shift availability. 37.5 hours a week, five days out of seven, on shifts between 8am and 6pm Monday to Sunday. That normally means one weekend a month.

  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance, for you and your family

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

Equal opportunities 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Overview of the Product Team

Product Managers at Zego are change-makers. We build and scale data-driven, impactful solutions that enable Zego to offer competitive and personalised insurance. Working in a fast-paced Agile environment, our team thrives on innovation, cross-functional collaboration, and driving measurable outcomes.

We’re building a product organisation where AI isn’t a buzzword - it’s how we work. From rapid prototyping with generative AI to using machine learning models that power our core pricing, our PMs operate at the frontier of what technology can do for insurance.

From enhancing pricing models to streamlining digital experiences, our Product team is instrumental in shaping the future of insurance.

 

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager who combines strategic depth with a hands-on builder’s instinct. You’ll own strategic workstreams that span multiple teams and business domains, defining the 6-12 month product direction and shaping how Zego’s products evolve to meet ambitious commercial targets.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and leadership. You’ll define new product mechanics and revenue models. You’ll make build-vs-buy-vs-partner recommendations that shape Zego’s competitive position. And you’ll champion an experiment-first culture - using AI to compress discovery cycles, generate sharper insights, and ship at a velocity that sets the standard for the rest of the organisation.

You’ll work closely with Zego’s Leadership Team on strategic decisions, lead cross-functional programmes, and mentor Product Managers - raising the bar for how the entire product community operates.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Set the six-to-12-month product strategy across multiple teams and domains, including the build, buy or partner calls that shape Zego's competitive position.

  • Define and validate new revenue mechanics, from 0 to 1 propositions to upsell and retention loops, grounded in unit economics and customer insight rather than gut feel.

Purpose of the role

The External Reporting Manager is accountable for the delivery of statutory accounts, the SFCR narrative, the external audit cycle, the tax compliance pack and FCA / GFSC regulatory returns across the Group and MGA. You'll work directly with the Finance Director, the actuarial function, the Director of Legal and Regulatory Affairs, external auditors (Deloitte) and external tax advisors - and you'll have real visibility with the CFO, the Audit Committee and the Board.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own a meaty external reporting remit end-to-end, in a regulated environment, with the breadth of an insurance group and the pace of a tech company.

Why this role and why now?

You'll be the single accountable lead for the full external reporting cycle of the Group and MGA, working directly with the Finance Director and CFO, with regular Audit Committee exposure. You'll be supported by, and expected to lead, a Finance function that's genuinely AI-native. If you want to build the technical depth of a Big 4 senior manager, with the breadth and pace of a scale-up, this is the seat.

What you’ll be doing

Statutory accounts (FRS 102) & External audit management

  • Prepare and deliver annual statutory financial statements for the MGA and Group holding entities under FRS 102.

  • Draft technical accounting papers on judgemental areas (intangibles, going concern, intra-group transactions, R&D and other tax items) and own the disclosure checklist.

  • Maintain the group accounting manual and ensure consistent policy application across UK, Gibraltar and Portuguese entities.

  • Act as the primary day-to-day contact for Deloitte across the MGA and Group. Run the audit timetable, deliverables tracker and Prepared By Client list.

  • Manage substantive audit queries, draft responses on technical positions, and prepare the Audit Committee paper pack.

  • Close out management letter points within agreed timescales.

SFCR (Solvency II Pillar 3 narrative reporting)

  • Own the production and consolidation of the annual SFCR narrative across Sections A to E, working closely with the actuarial team (who own the QRTs and technical provisions), risk and capital management, and the Director of Legal and Regulatory Affairs.

  • Co-ordinate the cross-functional sign-off process and the external regulatory audit of the SFCR.

Tax & FCA / GFSC regulatory reporting

  • Coordinate the corporation tax compliance cycle with external advisors (current and deferred tax computations, group relief, transfer pricing documentation).

  • Manage VAT (including any partial exemption and reclaim positions), PAYE/PSA, and the R&D tax credit cycle including any HMRC enquiry support.

  • Own the tax provisioning conversation in the year-end accounts and maintain the SAO sign-off file.

  • Prepare and submit FCA returns for the MGA and Group (RMAR / RegData), and group-level GFSC returns. Maintain the regulatory reporting calendar and the controls framework around submissions (data lineage, four-eyes review, evidence pack). Support ad hoc regulatory requests and thematic reviews.

Controls, process and team

  • Operate and improve the financial reporting control framework (key controls catalogue, evidence packs, reconciliations).

  • Drive automation and the use of AI and reporting tools to compress close timelines and improve quality.

  • Mentor junior team members and act as a technical sounding board across the wider Finance team.

What you’ll need to be successful

  • ACA / ACCA qualified, ideally Big 4 or Top 10 trained with a financial services portfolio

  • 2-4 years post-qualified experience in industry or audit

  • Insurance, MGA or broader financial services background

  • Hands-on experience preparing statutory accounts under FRS 102

  • Working knowledge of the SFCR narrative structure and the regulatory reporting environment

  • Experience working through an external audit, ideally from both auditor and auditee sides

  • Working knowledge of UK corporation tax, VAT and R&D tax credits

  • Strong technical writing - auditor-ready papers and clean disclosure prose

  • Advanced Excel; comfortable with large data sets and reconciliations

  • Active and curious user of AI tools in day-to-day work

Desirable

  • Exposure to a multi-entity group structure, including offshore (Gibraltar / Guernsey) or European subsidiaries

  • Familiarity with FCA RMAR / RegData and GFSC returns

  • Python, SQL or Snowflake skills

  • Experience working in a fast-growth, scale-up or fintech / insurtech environment

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

Platform & Architecture

  • Experience building Data Mesh or Lakehouse architectures.

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Purpose of the role

We don't build pricing models, we build the driving intelligence that feeds them. Our mission is fairer insurance, priced on how people drive, not on who they are, and safer roads.

The Telematics team turns raw phone sensor data into meaningful signals about how people drive. Using signal processing and machine learning on high-frequency GPS, accelerometer, and gyroscope data, we extract the behavioural features that power Zego's understanding of driving quality, context, and risk.

The Telematics Data Science team collaborates daily with engineering, product, and actuarial colleagues across the UK and PT. We're one team across Portugal and the UK. PT and UK roles carry the same scope, ownership, and progression. Decisions get made where the work happens, not in a single headquarters. This isn't a solo remote seat; you'll join an established team of peers.

Few teams use phone sensor data to price commercial motor insurance at scale. As a Lead Data Scientist, you'll shape how millions of trips are turned into risk signals. You'll own behavioural features and algorithms from hypothesis to production, working at the intersection of data science and engineering on GPS, inertial, and other sensor data.

You'll move between quick heuristics and full ML models depending on what the problem calls for. You ship code to production, not just notebooks.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Work with raw, high-frequency sensor data: GPS, accelerometer, gyroscope, at scale. This isn't warehouse-tabular data: it's noisy, physical, and where the signal actually lives. You'll be processing more than 250k trips per day.

  • Research new behavioural features and detection algorithms: read the literature, try ideas, kill the ones that don't survive contact with real data.

  • Design and build behavioural features and factors that feed Zego's understanding of driving quality, context, and risk.

  • Take ideas from hypothesis to production: prototyping in notebooks, then writing the production-grade Python and SQL that scales.

  • Prioritise simple, robust solutions, rule-based when that's enough, ML when it's warranted.

  • Lead experiments, validate impact with data, and automate insight generation.

  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and and actuaries to get features into the pricing path and measure their effect on real policies.

  • Translate complex sensor data into clear findings that non-technical stakeholders can act on.

What You'll need to be successful

  • MSc (or integrated MEng/MSc) in a quantitative field: Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, or similar. This is a core role that requires strong engineering foundations.

  • Working knowledge of digital signal processing or sensor physics. You can reason about noise, sampling, filtering, and the physical meaning behind a signal, not just its numbers.

  • Proven track record delivering data science or data engineering projects into production. You write production-grade code, not just notebooks.

  • Strong Python and SQL (we use Snowflake). Comfortable with the scientific Python stack: Polars, Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, and scikit-learn.

  • Experience developing and evaluating ML models on tabular data classification or regression tasks where evaluation matters as much as model choice. Think passenger-vs-driver detection, transport-mode classification, or score predictiveness.

  • You've designed, built, and maintained data pipelines from scratch: reliable, observable, and scalable.

  • Fluent with AI coding assistants as part of daily engineering work. We use Claude Code across the team and expect candidates to be comfortable working with tools of this kind.

  • Strong communicator: you translate ambiguous problems into structured, testable ideas, and share insights clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Growth mindset: curious, open to feedback, driven to keep improving.

  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience applying signal processing to noisy, high-frequency sensor/time-series data (GPS, accelerometer, IMU) in production.

  • Exposure to insurance, mobile data, or behaviour modelling.

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS), containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), or data orchestration frameworks.

  • Familiarity with our ML and tooling stack: MLflow for experiment tracking, DVC for data versioning, Streamlit for internal apps and demos.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance, for you and your family

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

title: Head of Telematics Data Science
original_description:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Purpose of the role

Zego has recorded over a billion miles of real-world driving, captured from phone sensors (accelerometer, GPS and more) across tens of thousands of policies and four very different kinds of driving: private car, van, taxi and delivery. The Telematics team uses digital signal processing and machine learning to turn that raw signal into a precise picture of how people actually drive. We use it to price insurance more fairly, to help drivers be safer on the road, and to power Zego Rewards, everyday rewards for good driving that turn car insurance into an engaging product rather than a box to tick.

We own the full telematics stack (mobile SDK, on-device ML, cloud pipeline) and the full pricing stack. So we can link driving behaviour directly to claim type, frequency and severity, and feed one system's predictions straight into the other. We are one of very few companies that owns that entire loop end to end, on in-house proprietary technology.

As Head of Telematics Data Science you will set the research agenda and own the technical direction of that work, reporting to the Director of Data. You will lead three data scientists directly and three ML engineers with a dotted line to you. The split is roughly 60% leading, 40% hands-on.

Our long-term ambition is driving behaviour modelling that holds up across countries and handsets, is highly predictive of claims risk, and is deeply integrated with driver coaching so we can offer the fairest price and the best experience to good drivers anywhere. Our partnership with Sompo Holdings, one of Japan's largest insurance groups, will take models trained on UK roads into an entirely different market.

 

The problems you will be working on

  • Continuously pushing the predictive power of our existing algorithms and ML models

  • Telling drivers apart from passengers using sensor data alone

  • Detecting crashes and estimating their severity

  • Bringing map and road-context data into our models in a way that genuinely improves prediction

  • Handling handset and sensor heterogeneity, so a model behaves consistently on a five-year-old Android and a new iPhone

  • On-device ML under real battery and compute constraints - trip detection already runs on the phone, and more could

  • Making behavioural risk models transfer to new markets, starting with Japan

 

Several of these are open problems across the industry, not just at Zego.

 

What you will be doing

  • Define and drive the technical roadmap, making sure the team is working on the highest-impact problems

  • Lead the development of novel models to detect human behaviour and vehicle kinematics from high-frequency phone sensor data, on-device and in the cloud

  • Act as the primary technical authority on telematics across the business, advising on existing products, surfacing patterns nobody has thought to look for, and identifying new value propositions

  • Build, grow and mentor the team, setting the technical standards needed to produce exceptional work

  • Partner with Pricing to integrate telematics predictions into how we price risk, and with Data Products and Engineering to embed telematics insight into Zego's core products

  • Push our use of AI in the work itself in analytics, in model development, and in the driver coaching experiences we are building

  • Represent our telematics science to senior leadership, commercial teams and partners including Sompo

  • Own the metrics that track real-world model impact in production, and make sure our models meet our obligations around fair pricing when a model influences what someone pays, the fairness of that model is part of the job

What you will need to be successful

  • A Master's or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or a related quantitative field though we are equally happy to talk to people with equivalent industry research experience

  • Deep expertise in machine learning and deep learning, preferably with hands-on experience building and deploying models on high-frequency time-series sensor data

  • A strong grounding in signal processing: signal modelling, decomposition, transforms and sensor physics

  • Experience leading and growing a data science team developing people and delivering through others, without losing touch with the technical work

  • Strong software engineering practice: Python, version control, reproducible pipelines and production-ready code

  • Experience with large-scale data processing (we use Kafka, Spark and Flink)

  • The ability to explain complex technical work clearly to senior leadership, commercial teams and partners, and a bias for connecting research to business outcomes

  • Preferably, experience with on-device or embedded ML under compute and power constraints

  • Familiarity with regulated environments, or with fairness and bias in applied models, is a plus

  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance, for you and your family

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

Equal opportunities 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Purpose of the role 🎯

We're looking for a Data Engineer to join our data engineering function, helping to build and maintain the data platform that powers Zego's ambitious growth.

This is a hands-on technical role. You'll build and maintain scalable, reliable, and secure data pipelines, working within an established platform and architecture. You'll work closely with peers across Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Product to ensure our data infrastructure is efficient and reliable.

AI is central to how we work at Zego, and that extends to engineering. You'll be encouraged to use AI tools to move faster, automate the routine, and focus your time on the problems that matter most, while staying thoughtful about where and how they add value.

You'll learn from experienced engineers across the team, and you'll be encouraged to grow your technical skills while contributing to high-quality, well-tested work.

What you will be doing 🛠️

Technical Delivery

  • Build, maintain, and improve data pipelines and related systems.

  • Follow and help uphold best practices in data engineering, including testing, CI/CD, observability, and infrastructure as code.

  • Take part in code reviews and team knowledge sharing.

Platform & Data

  • Build and maintain data pipelines, warehouses, and streaming systems within our existing architecture.

  • Ensure data is modelled and structured to meet the needs of analytics, data science, and operational use cases.

  • Contribute to improvements in our data systems and tooling.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work with teams across the business to understand requirements and turn them into reliable technical solutions.

  • Help identify opportunities for optimisation and tool improvements.

  • Deliver against the technical roadmap for data engineering.

What you will need to be successful 🏆

  • Experience: 2+ years as a Data Engineer working on data platforms, ideally in product-led or high-growth environments.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Experience building and operating ETL/ELT pipelines.

    • Hands-on experience with modern data stacks — our tech includes Python, SQL, Snowflake, Apache Iceberg, AWS S3, PostgresDB, Airflow, dbt, and Apache Spark, deployed via AWS, Docker, and Terraform (experience with some of these or similar technologies is expected).

  • Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with teammates and stakeholders.

  • Problem-Solving: Pragmatic approach to balancing quality with delivery needs.

  • Growth Mindset: Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow your technical skills.

  • Familiarity with Data Mesh or Lakehouse architectures.

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, and real-time streaming technologies (e.g. Kafka, Kinesis).

  • Exposure to ML engineering pipelines or MLOps frameworks.

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. Claims complaints at an insurer are where things get real — the customer is already in distress, the stakes are higher, and poor handling has direct regulatory consequences.

  • Manage day-to-day operations across case assignment, workload distribution, and queue management

  • Monitor KPIs and identify areas for improvement

Quality & Compliance

  • Sign off Final Response Letters, ensuring they are clear, fair, and evidence a full investigation

  • Keep complaints logged, acknowledged, and progressed within DISP timescales

  • Apply Consumer Duty and vulnerable customer standards consistently across all case handling

  • Work with Claims Technical, Underwriting, and Legal & Regulatory Affairs on coverage, avoidance, or legal risk complaints

  • Partner with the Customer Support & FOS Team Leader to maintain consistent standards across the function

  • Decisions worth making. You'll use quantitative and qualitative evidence to work out what's really going on, then make the call and defend it in front of the leadership team. Analysis that doesn't impact a decision isn't the job.

  • AI that does real work. You'll design and build AI systems and workflows that take work off people's plates, in content, analysis, operations or reporting. We expect you to reach for AI first, and to be the person others copy.

  • The narrative. Company wide updates, investor material, Board packs. You'll turn complicated business reality into something a smart outsider can follow in ten minutes.

  • Proof you've done something hard. A business you built, a product you launched, a number you moved, a broken thing you fixed. We care about what happened, not what you were responsible for.

  • Real AI fluency. You've built your own tools, agents or workflows, not just used a chatbot. Come ready to show us.

  • Speed with judgement. You've worked somewhere genuinely fast, most likely a high growth startup, strategy consulting or similar and you know the difference between impact and effort.

  • Comfort with numbers and with people. You can build the model, then sit with an underwriter, a regulator or a shareholder and be taken seriously in both rooms.

title: Marketing and Brand Designer (UK)
original_description:
About Nexus Black

Nexus Black is an AI-first business within IFS, built to move quickly, challenge traditional ways of working, and turn the potential of AI into real-world outcomes for enterprise customers. We build AI to solve hard problems for the industries that keep the world turning: up on power lines, down on factory floors, and out in the field.

Our products — Resolve (field service and predictive maintenance), Flow (production planning), Comply (regulatory compliance) and Reason (analytical reasoning) — are used by technicians and engineers who cannot afford a tool that doesn't work first time. We pair 40 years of IFS industrial depth with the technical pace of a start-up, and we get results in weeks, not months.

We're building a team of highly capable, high-ownership people who are comfortable operating across traditional boundaries. We care less about rigid job descriptions and more about people who can understand a problem, get hands-on, and own the outcome.

The Role

We're looking for a Marketing and Brand Designer to be the visual engine of our marketing team. Someone equally comfortable designing a social carousel, laying out a leaflet, mocking up an event booth, and cutting a short motion piece for video. You'll work closely with marketing, events, and content colleagues to make sure every touchpoint, digital or physical looks and feels unmistakably NxB.

This is a hands-on, generalist creative role. You won't specialise in one format; you'll flex across all of them, often in the same week.

What You'll Do

• Design social content across channels (LinkedIn, X, etc.) — static and short-form

• Build and maintain website content and landing page assets

• Design print and physical collateral: leaflets, one-pagers, sales materials

• Create event assets: booth mockups, floor plans, signage, banners, and on-site branding

• Produce motion graphics and video assets — edits, animated graphics, social cuts, event loops

• Partner closely with the marketing team to translate campaign briefs into visual output at speed

• Maintain and evolve brand consistency across every format you touch

• Manage multiple concurrent projects with tight event/campaign deadlines

Skills & Experience

Core (must-have):

• Strong portfolio spanning both digital and physical design (not purely digital-only work)

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) or Figma equivalent

• Working knowledge of motion/video tools (After Effects, Premiere Pro, or similar)

• Experience designing for print production (bleed, CMYK, file prep for printers)

• Experience with event/environmental design — booth layouts, signage, large-format print

• Solid grasp of brand systems — typography, colour, layout consistency across formats

• Comfortable working directly with a marketing team, turning briefs around quickly

Nice-to-have:

• 3D mockup / rendering skills for booth or environment visualisation (SketchUp, Cinema 4D, or similar)

• Basic animation/motion design beyond edits (Lottie, simple 2D animation)

• Photography or videography experience for event/on-site content capture

• Familiarity with web design handoff (Webflow, or working alongside developers)

What Success Looks Like

• Marketing campaigns launch with consistent, on-brand assets across every channel without bottlenecks

• Events are visually strong on-site — from signage to booth to leaflets — with minimal last-minute scrambling

• Social and video content feels distinct, not templated, and holds up against category competitors

title: Account Management Lead - Editions France
original_description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

    • Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

    • Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

    • Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

    • Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

    • Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

  • Occupancy & Commercial Performance

    • Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

    • Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

    • Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

    • Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

  • P&L Ownership & Governance

    • Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

    • Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

    • Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

  • Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

  • Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

  • Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

  • Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

  • Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

  • Senior Stakeholder Management

    • Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events

    • Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends

  • Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network

 

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • 7+ years working in commercially focused roles

  • Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams

  • Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience

  • Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time

  • Mix of both strategy and execution experience

  • Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators

  • Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams

  • Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations

  • You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)

  • Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable

  • Fluent in French and English is required

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Account Manager - Groceries & Retail
original_description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d'un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

En tant qu'Account Manager, vous serez responsable du succès de votre portefeuille de comptes, afin d'assurer une expérience magique à nos utilisateurs, tout en construisant un socle solide et durable pour notre application.

 

MISSIONS :

  • Votre objectif sera de créer un partenariat privilégié, durable en apportant votre expertise marketplace, foodtech et account management.

  • Vous aurez comme missions principales la gestion et l'optimisation de la croissance et la profitabilité d'un portefeuille de partenaires et le respect des objectifs fixés (opérationnels et commerciaux, ventes de services)

  • Vous développerez des joint business plans avec les principaux acteurs de votre portefeuille en vous appuyant sur des routines (price, range, roll out, ops, tech review) pour faire croître le partenariat des comptes de votre équipe.

  • Vous serez en charge du déploiement et de l'expansion de votre portefeuille ainsi que des différentes campagnes Marketing que vous devrez négocier dans le cadre du "joint business plan".

  • Analyse quotidienne de la data de la performance des marques et de nos opérations Deliveroo pour identifier les causes des problèmes et améliorer constamment le niveau de service.

  • Optimisation et gestion de processus : Deliveroo est une société qui évolue à grande vitesse et à grande échelle. Vous aurez l'opportunité de créer et améliorer des processus, par exemple la gestion de partenariats pour contribuer à la croissance. Vous élaborerez des outils et des guides de meilleures pratiques pour des comptes spécifiques et pour l'ensemble du portefeuille.

  • Vous veillerez au suivi du respect des engagements contractuels pris avec les partenaires de votre portefeuille.

 

PROFIL :

  • 3 à 6 ans d'expérience d'account management ou de commercial. Une expérience chez une grande enseigne de la grande distribution serait un vrai plus.

  • Commercial: vous savez négocier, anticiper des discussions commerciales, entreprendre des actions afin de maintenir un portefeuille de qualité (discussions contractuelles, négociations de mise en place d'outils commerciaux, etc)

  • Stratégique: vous savez prendre du recul, comprendre des problématiques non structurées et proposer des solutions via des plans d'actions et un suivi de résultats

  • Analytique: capable d'être synthétique, d'approfondir les données et de comprendre les données qui permettent d'améliorer les performances pour nos partenaires en magasins

  • Proactif(-ive): vous adorez être sur le terrain et vous êtes impliqué(e) dans tout ce qui est opérationnel dans votre périmètre.

  • Centré(e) sur le client: être obsédé par nos clients. Utiliser des données quantitatives et qualitatives pour construire un service qui soit opérationnellement excellent pour nos clients.

  • Français et Anglais courant indispensables

 

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l'article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité professionnelle, l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. Deliveroo France valorise la diversité sans discrimination de genre, race, sexualité, religion ou préférences personnelles. Avec un score de 98/100 à l'Indice de l'Égalité Hommes-Femmes 2024, nous sommes engagés envers l'égalité des chances. Rejoignez-nous avec votre passion pour la nourriture dans une entreprise en pleine croissance.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Head of Partner Marketing, France
original_description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Nous recherchons un(e) Head of Partner Marketing France pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing France, basée à Paris.

Rattaché(e) à la Head of Marketing France, vous piloterez l'une des trois équipes Marketing du marché français et managerez une équipe de 6 personnes.

Votre mission : faire de nos partenaires (Restaurants, Grocery, Retail…) l'une des principales raisons pour lesquelles les consommateurs choisissent notre plateforme.

À la croisée du Marketing et du Commercial, vous définirez la stratégie Partner Marketing du marché français, imaginerez des campagnes et des partenariats créatifs qui renforcent notre marque et recrutent de nouveaux clients, tout en accompagnant la croissance de nos partenaires et les priorités business de l'entreprise.

Ce que vous ferez:

  • Définir la stratégie Partner Marketing pour nos différents segments (Restaurants, Grocery, Retail, National Accounts, Global Key Accounts…), en cohérence avec les priorités Global et les enjeux du marché français.

  • Imaginer des campagnes et des activations créatives qui mettent en valeur nos partenaires et créent de la préférence de marque : partenariats exclusifs, lancements, expériences, collaborations ou opérations spéciales capables de recruter de nouveaux clients et de générer de l'engagement.

  • Construire des plans marketing sur mesure pour nos partenaires stratégiques, en conciliant objectifs commerciaux, ambitions marketing et expérience client.

  • Être le partenaire stratégique des équipes commerciales, en comprenant les enjeux business, en participant à la construction de propositions de valeur et en transformant les opportunités commerciales en plateformes marketing différenciantes.

  • Fédérer les équipes (Sales, Promotions, Brand & Media, Integrated Marketing, Creative, CRM, Analytics et Global) afin de construire des plans marketing intégrés et de faire émerger les meilleures idées collectives.

  • Manager et développer une équipe de 6 personnes, en apportant vision, coaching, structure et exigence d'exécution, afin de faire monter l'équipe en compétences et en autonomie.

  • Piloter la performance, grâce à une forte culture de la donnée, en mesurant l'impact des actions, en priorisant les initiatives et en assurant une exécution irréprochable.

Le profil recherché

Vous êtes un(e) leader marketing capable de combiner vision stratégique, créativité et sens du business.

Vous apportez notamment :

  • 6/7+ ans d'expérience en Marketing, avec une expérience significative dans la définition de stratégies marketing à fort impact.

  • Une solide compréhension des enjeux commerciaux et de la manière dont le marketing peut accélérer la croissance d'un business et créer de la valeur pour des partenaires.

  • Une forte sensibilité créative et une excellente culture de marque, avec la capacité d'imaginer des campagnes qui marquent les esprits autant qu'elles délivrent des résultats.

  • Une capacité reconnue à influencer et fédérer des équipes dans un environnement matriciel, en créant de l'alignement autour d'une vision commune.

  • Une expérience réussie en management et dans le développement de talents.

  • Une approche à la fois stratégique, structurée et très orientée exécution, avec une forte culture de la donnée.

  • Une maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais.

Ce qui vous permettra de réussir:

  • Vision stratégique

  • Créativité et sens de la marque

  • Business & commercial acumen

  • Leadership et coaching

  • Influence et collaboration transverse

  • Analyse de données et prise de décision

  • Priorisation et excellence opérationnelle

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

title: Lead Software Engineer - Performance Marketing
original_description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

 


Team

Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech across various types of games and consumer apps.

 

Role

Voodoo is looking for a Lead Software Engineer for our Playable Ads team as part of our Central Growth Team. In this role, you'll lead key initiatives developed by our playable ads team, while staying hands-on with production and driving innovation in our playable ad formats across games.

 

Key tasks

  • Lead and coach a small team of playable ads developers/strategists embedded within franchise-dedicated squads, ensuring high autonomy and strong performance

  • Stay hands-on with playable ad production, contributing directly to the creation and iteration of high-quality playable creatives

  • Oversee operational topics for the playable team, including workflows, tooling, and best practices

  • Drive innovation in playable ad formats, constantly exploring new mechanics, interactions, and creative concepts to stay ahead of market trends

  • Collaborate closely with the Growth Manager and creative strategists to align on priorities and franchise-level objectives

  • Benchmark competitor playable ads and analyze performance data to improve production quality and effectiveness

  • Act as a technical and/or strategic reference for the team, providing guidance on both development and marketing performance topics

  • Support the rollout of playable ads across multiple game franchises, adapting formats to each title's creative strategy

  • Contribute to defining and evolving the playable ads chapter's vision, standards, and processes


Profile

  • 4+ years of experience in playable ad or game development

  • Hands-on, maker mindset - you're comfortable getting into production yourself while also stepping back to coordinate

  • Experience with relevant playable ads development tools or frameworks Unity (Luna), Cocos Creator or other relevant platforms

  • Knowledge of object-oriented programming and web game development

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and asset generation (Scenario, Flux, ElevenLabs)

  • Solid understanding of mobile marketing performance metrics and creative testing

  • Proven ability to mentor and coach peers

  • You have entrepreneurial mindset and can adapt to a high-paced environment

  • You can demonstrate excellent teamwork and collaboration skills

  • You are fluent in English (fluency in French is a plus)

 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary upon experience

  • Swile restaurant lunch voucher

  • Gymlib sports subscription (100% taken in charge by us)

  • Sidecare healthcare coverage for your family

  • Child day care facilities (Les Petits Chaperons rouge)

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • Creative hackathon

  • Unlimited vacation policy

  • Full stack desk and computer equipment upon your request

  • Cooperate within a globally diverse team and a rich cross-cultural work environment

title: Software Engineer - Performance Marketing
original_description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 1,000+ employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Paper.io, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Our Growth team helps maximize the potential of each Voodoo product within the ecosystem. Our Growth team is split across several areas of expertise, such as user acquisition, ad monetization, video ads, playable ads, and influencer marketers. Being part of the Growth Team at Voodoo requires strong operational excellence and creativity in order to constantly adapt and stay ahead of the market.

The core mission of the Playable Ads team is to create engaging and interactive advertising experiences that captivate audiences and drive conversions. We work with playable developers and coordinators that turn a game into an HTML interactive ad experience. Your main mission will be to produce high-performing ads by creating and uploading them to our various ad networks.

Role

We are looking for talented individuals interested in creating playable ads that let users try our games! To succeed in this role, you need extensive Unity development experience with a past of creating unique user experiences for a global audience. You will be converting existing games into playable ads and collaborating on the creation of tools for other interactive ad formats.

  • Transform existing games into interactive user experiences

  • Optimize playable ads for the best user experience, scalability, and adaptability

  • Integrate an analytics solution to measure interactions and gain insights to offer the best user experience

  • Build interactive playable templates that can be customized by graphic designers

  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives (e.g. testing new tools, implementing new processes, etc.)

  • Develop a deep understanding of how your creations perform and why

  • Work within a small creative squad with amazing people from diverse backgrounds and nationalities

  • Have the opportunity to cover different product scopes (e.g., hypercasual, casual, consumer apps, etc.)

  • Become a creative expert in mobile gaming: benchmark what our competitors are doing, experiment with new ideas

Profile

  • Fully proficient in playable ad creation or in developing Unity projects (size optimized to be used as playable)

  • Experience creating playable ads in Unity (Luna), Cocos Creator or any relevant platform

  • Adequate knowledge of object-oriented programming and web game development

  • Proactive problem diagnosis and creative problem-solving skills

  • Fluent in English, both oral and written

  • 3+ years of experience in a similar role

  • Deeply familiar with the mobile gaming market, in particular, hyper casual and casual games

  • Creative mindset and knowledge in game design

  • Familiarity with 3rd party SDKs, analytics, and A/B testing in mobile games (preferred but not essential)

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and asset generation (Scenario, Flux, ElevenLabs)

Benefits

Competitive salary and other benefits according to the country you reside in.

Full remote for candidates based abroad, with relocation to Paris subject to discussion. Hybrid for candidates based in France.

title: Enterprise Sales Lead (French market)
original_description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end: you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan.

About the Enterprise segment

  • Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees

  • Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc)

  • Total Addressable Market: ~7M members in France

Why Enterprise Sales is exciting at Alan

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers, Unions, long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine.

More precisely, you will:

  • Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment.

  • Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come)

    • Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow‑up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management.

    • Be on the field with the team: prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers: Surface customer expectations, patterns, and blockers, and ensure they’re addressed through the right strategic and execution plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? You may be a great fit at Alan if you... ⭐

  • Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction, and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and advanced level in English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands‑on mentality: you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data‑driven and analytical: you know how to leverage KPIs to drive performance, run analyses, and make decisions

  • Have strong cross‑functional collaboration skills and appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience selling to HR or Finance

.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.
